# requireValidPresentationId

<link-summary>Returns the value as a presentation id, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireValidPresentationId() — Returns the value as a presentation id, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireValidPresentationId(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a valid presentation id."
): string;
```

At least 25 characters of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores — the id from a Slides URL. The format is all that is checked.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                      | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                        | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a valid presentation id."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`string` — the same value, typed as a presentation id.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                           |
| :------------------------- | :---------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the value is not a presentation id. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
requireValidPresentationId("1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"); // => "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"
requireValidPresentationId("short-id"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidPresentationId("has space in it and is long enough to pass"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
